title: Personal Protective Equipment, Part 2: Safety Footwear

regulatory_compliance.qco_order: Footwear made from Leather and other materials (Quality Control) Order, 2024

clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 15298 (PART 2)) covers Personal Protective Equipment, Part 2: Safety Footwear. This Indian Standard (Part 2) (First Revision) wiiich is identical with ISO 20345 : 2004 'Personal protective equipment — Safety footwear' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the of the Chemical Division Council. This standard was first published in 2002 which was identical to ISO 8782-2 : 1998 'Safety, protective and occupational footwear for professional use — Part 2: Specification for safety footwear' which has been superseded by ISO 20345 : 2004. The committee has decided to revise this standard by adopting ISO 20345 : 2004. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as an Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards.
